page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6e.large is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at 2.5 GHz. It features 2 physical cores and 2 vCPUs, configured with 1.0 thread per core. The hardware profile includes 4.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB per core. This instance does not include local storage or GPU hardware, relying on external storage solutions, and is provisioned with a baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates that the instance delivers modest processing and memory capabilities. The Geekbench single-core score of 1156.0 falls within the average range, while the multi-core score of 1379.0 is positioned in the bottom 10% of tested systems. Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only small block cached speed of 96.8 GB/sec, but large block uncached read and write speeds drop to 12.97 GB/sec and 11.91 GB/sec respectively. Computational workloads such as software compilation, ray tracing, and image processing also rank in the bottom 10% of performance tiers.

With a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the instance represents a compute-oriented entry-level configuration. The lack of bundled local storage and modest network bandwidth limits its utility for high-throughput data processing or large-scale database operations, as reflected in the Passmark database score of 708.59 and Redis SET performance of 1.7 million operations per second. It is qualitatively positioned as a low-cost option for lightweight, single-threaded tasks, basic web serving, or development environments that do not require high memory density or local disk I/O.
